instruction: Set up a global hotkey for play/pause in VLC preferences.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring a global hotkey for play/pause in VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Hotkeys > Global hotkeys). The evaluator checks VLC config file for global-key-play-pause having a value (not empty). Uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric from vlc.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify the instruction
Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly extracts VLC configuration file from VM
Metric (check_global_key_play_pause) correctly checks if global-key-play-pause setting has any value configured
Expected value '1' correctly represents 'hotkey configured' vs '0' for 'not configured'
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting up global hotkey, evaluator verifies it is configured
Correct parameter handling: metric receives rules dict directly (not nested), accesses rule['expected_global_key_play_pause'] correctly
Edge cases handled: file not found exception, default value initialization, missing config line
No postconfig needed: VLC config persists to disk after task completion
Data flow correct: VLC config → metric reads file → checks if value is empty or set → returns match
